description: Perched above the cloud veil upon Mount Solitude, the Astral Archive contains celestial observatories, crystalline starlight mirrors, and the grand culmination of the Convergence mystery.

districts.name: The Observatory Beyond Dawn
districts.flavor: A tiered marble promontory where giant brass astrolabes align with constellations that predate the First Resonance.

districts.name: The Auroral Scriptorium
districts.flavor: Endless shelves of floating starlight scrolls and crystallized card tablets penned by the original Convergence scholars.

districts.name: The Celestial Spire
districts.flavor: A spindle of pure, translucent glass where the eight elemental leylines converge into a blinding vertical pillar of Aether.

districts.name: Sanctum of the First Conjunction
districts.flavor: The legendary arena where the Grand Champion must duel the Avatar of the Convergence to decide the fate of the Great Accord.

dialogue.greeting: You have walked from the docks of Lumenport, through the roots and the iron gorges, to stand beneath our stars.
dialogue.friendly: The alignment is nearing totality. The eight banners must unite or dissolve into dissonance.
dialogue.bonded: You bear the true resonance of the Wanderer. Stand beside me at the Zenith.
dialogue.victory: Breathtaking! You weave the cards as constellations in the night sky.
dialogue.defeat: The light was too blinding. Recalibrate your perspective, champion.

dialogue.greeting: I am the echo of every duel fought upon this earth. Show me that your victory was earned, not gifted.
dialogue.friendly: Few mortals cross this threshold with their minds unbroken by the Aether.
dialogue.bonded: The Great Accord shall endure in your hands.
dialogue.victory: It is done. The cards have spoken, and the four realms are bound anew.
dialogue.defeat: Return to the hearth, Wanderer, until your resolve outshines the stars.

quests.title: Act 4 Chapter 1: The Zenith Alignment
quests.objective: Align the 3 celestial focal lenses in the Observatory Beyond Dawn by defeating the Archive Guardians.

quests.title: Act 4 Climax: The Final Convergence Duel
quests.objective: Defeat the Convergence Sovereign in a master 1v1 duel to complete the main Hearthglass campaign.
